# beenfar_radius_server (Data Source)

Looks up a RADIUS server by id or name. The shared secret is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beenfar_radius_server" "corp" {
  name = "corp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Server id. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Server name. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `accounting_port` (Number) Accounting port; 0 means no accounting.
- `address` (String) IP address of the server.
- `auth_port` (Number) Authentication port.
- `shared_secret_version` (Number) Increases whenever the shared secret changes.
